locations.text: You are standing in the village’s central square — a spacious area surrounded by old buildings. In the very center rises a mighty oak, its thick trunk and sprawling branches casting shade over the cracked cobblestones. On one side of the square stands a tavern, lively voices drifting from within, while on the other are several shops offering various goods. In the air, you hear the rhythmic ring of a hammer coming from a nearby smithy. The village seems peaceful, yet there's a subtle feeling of anticipation — as if something is about to happen.
Are you sure you want to quit?
